objective: Test whether a direct lexical-token risk emission can prevent false onset persistence while retaining asymmetric onset and continuation/stop structure.

data_and_split.leakage_rule: Every group is wholly held out before scaler, weights, priors, or heads are fit.

geometry.token_axis: lexical raw Llama-2 BPEs from the frozen fit token cache
geometry.risk_target: released character-span union mapped to lexical BPEs
geometry.window: fixed width 4 raw BPE, stride 1, eligible iff at least one lexical BPE
geometry.window_score: maximum lexical-token score in the window

causal_scalars: mean nll over current and previous three lexical tokens
features.normalization: unweighted lexical-token mean/std from the outer-training groups only

model.name: OSR-Emission-Anchor-68-v2

learned_heads.emission: sigmoid(w_emit*x_i+b_emit), target z_i at every lexical token
learned_heads.onset: sigmoid(w_on*x_i+b_on), target z_i only where gold z_(i-1)=0
learned_heads.continuation: sigmoid(w_cont*x_i+b_cont), target z_i only where gold z_(i-1)=1

model.terminal_rule: No fabricated EOS representation. A terminal risky token has no next lexical transition and contributes no duplicated stop cell.
model.balancing: Within each head, first give groups equal mass, answers equal mass within group, and cells equal mass within answer; then give the two classes equal mass using outer-training rows only.
model.prior_correction: For each head and fold, add logit(pi_train) to the balanced-head logit, where pi_train is the pre-class-balance hierarchical positive mass from that outer-training fold.

decoder_candidates_frozen_before_oof.name: anchored_filter
decoder_candidates_frozen_before_oof.definition: a_i=(1-q_(i-1))*p_on(i)+q_(i-1)*p_cont(i); q_i=sigmoid(logit(a_i)+logit(p_emit_balanced(i))). The balanced emission logit is a likelihood-ratio anchor, so sufficiently clean direct evidence can exit a false risk state.

selection.thresholds: For each frozen decoder and level separately, select one pooled fit-OOF threshold by maximum F1, then precision, recall, and largest threshold.
selection.calibration_use: None. No calibration threshold, label, error, score, or file may be read.

required_reporting: released-onset recall, internal-continuation recall, and clean FPR at the primary window threshold
all five fold metrics plus mean/std/min/max stability
code, protocol, data, cache, and output hashes

calibration_investment_gate.interpretation: The F1 floors are the already-recorded development reference in v1, used only as a conservative investment bar. Passing would authorize consideration of one later frozen calibration run; failing stops v2 without reading calibration.
